parsed.rationale_overall: System B provides deeper personalization by tying recommendations to specific profile attributes (legacy goal, variable income, $4M target math, age) and offers more concrete actionable steps with dollar amounts and execution timelines. While System A has slightly cleaner factual grounding and avoids some speculative claims, B's stronger diversification framing (addressing tech concentration and crypto/legacy tension) and superior actionability tip the overall comparison in its favor.
